name: Exp_TotalPowerIndicatorX
summary: This EA trades based on the Total Power Indicator X, which combines buying and selling pressure across multiple timeframes to generate momentum signals. It opens buy positions when buying pressure dominates and sell positions when selling pressure dominates, using configurable thresholds for entry and exit. The EA includes position management features such as stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop functionality.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Total Power Indicator X指标进行交易，该指标综合多个时间周期的买卖压力来生成动量信号。当买入压力占主导时开多仓，当卖出压力占主导时开空仓，使用可配置的阈值进行入场和出场。EA包含止损、止盈和移动止损等仓位管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是基于Total Power Indicator X指标衡量市场的买入和卖出动量强度。入场条件为当买入力量超过设定的阈值时做多，当卖出力量超过阈值时做空，属于典型的动量跟踪策略。出场条件包括止盈止损平仓、以及当动量信号反转或减弱时平仓。仓位管理方面支持固定手数交易，并可配置止损和止盈比例。资金管理方面采用了基础的风控设置，但未见明显的动态仓位调整或账户净值比例计算逻辑。该策略适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生较多假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is based on measuring market buying and selling momentum strength using the Total Power Indicator X. Entry conditions trigger a buy when buying power exceeds a configurable threshold and a sell when selling power exceeds its threshold, representing a classic momentum-following approach. Exit conditions include stop loss and take profit levels, as well as closing positions when momentum signals reverse or weaken. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading with configurable stop loss and take profit ratios. Money management incorporates basic risk control settings, but lacks dynamic position sizing or equity-proportional lot calculation logic. The strategy performs best in trending markets but may generate numerous false signals during choppy or range-bound conditions.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0为不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: BuyPowerThreshold
parameters.description: 买入力量阈值，超过此值开多仓
parameters.description_en: Buy power threshold; open long above this value

parameters.name: SellPowerThreshold
parameters.description: 卖出力量阈值，超过此值开空仓
parameters.description_en: Sell power threshold; open short above this value

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 指标计算时间周期，0为当前周期

pros: 多时间周期动量综合分析，信号更可靠
可配置的买卖力量阈值，灵活调整策略灵敏度
包含止损止盈和移动止损功能，具备基本风控
基于动量强弱判断方向，逻辑清晰易懂
pros_en: Multi-timeframe momentum synthesis provides more reliable signals
Configurable buy/sell power thresholds allow flexible strategy sensitivity tuning
Includes stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop for basic risk management
Direction based on momentum strength is logically clear and easy to understand
cons: 缺乏动态仓位管理，固定手数无法适应不同账户规模
在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损
未内置 spread 过滤机制，高 spread 环境下交易成本较高
缺少新K线判断逻辑，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks dynamic position sizing; fixed lots cannot adapt to different account sizes
Prone to frequent false signals in choppy/range-bound markets leading to consecutive losses
No built-in spread filter; high-spread environments increase trading costs significantly
Missing new bar check logic may cause repeated entries on the same candle
improvements: 增加基于账户净值比例的动态仓位计算功能
添加新K线判断机制避免同一根K线重复开仓
加入spread过滤和波动率过滤减少假信号
improvements_en: Add equity-proportional dynamic position sizing for better money management
Implement new bar detection to prevent duplicate entries on the same candle
Add spread filter and volatility filter to reduce false signals in unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 缺少新K线判断可能导致同一根K线上多次开仓
固定手数交易未考虑账户净值比例，大账户风险暴露过大或小账户利用率不足
震荡行情下动量信号频繁翻转可能造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same candle
Fixed lot sizing ignores equity ratio, leading to overexposure on large accounts or underutilization on small ones
Frequent momentum signal reversals in ranging markets can cause consecutive losses
